title: Retain the curvature contact when bounding a nonlinear force and all host energy excesses
statement: For H=H_G+H_A-lambda*w(Y)Q with bounded f=lambda*w prime*Q and f prime, the exact full uncentered KMS identity is Chi_qq=G+Gv[c+S_f]v^TG, c=<f prime>. It gives finite signed and absolute complete host kinetic/spring excess bounds, including |DeltaT|<=C*F0^2/8+(D0*hbar/8)sqrt(C/B0); exact momentum domination need not hold.

requires: Actual stable Gibbs host with positive constant M,K, coordinate-only C2 profile, bounded forceF0 and curvatureD0, and finite/internal or separately controlled rotor regulators.
provides: For H=H_G+H_A-lambda*w(Y)Q with bounded f=lambda*w prime*Q and f prime, the exact full uncentered KMS identity is Chi_qq=G+Gv[c+S_f]v^TG, c=<f prime>. It gives finite signed and absolute complete host kinetic/spring excess bounds, including |DeltaT|<=C*F0^2/8+(D0*hbar/8)sqrt(C/B0); exact momentum domination need not hold.
assumptions: c may have either sign. The c=0 linear theorem does not extend as an ordering to curved profiles. No cold spectral law or finite preparation follows from finite energy excess.
costs: Pay finite force/curvature and compliance; absolute spring excess<=C*F0^2/2+(D0/2)(kBT0*C+hbar*sqrt(C/B0)/4). Infinite baseline energy remains infinite.
contract.units: F0 is force, D0 force derivative, C compliance, B0 mass/inertia of Y, DeltaT and DeltaU energies; c has stiffness units.
contract.obstruction: Dropping the curvature contact silently creates a false linear-momentum-domination transfer.

body: The second host EOM with force insertion has the derivative equal-time contact [f,p_i]=i*hbar*v_i*f prime. S_f is positive and includes its mean at n=0. Scalar coth spectral sums and the compliance/port-mass moment give uniform L_M,L_K bounds. Positive majorants control sums of absolute local bond/kinetic changes before the lead limit, so no difference of two infinite reservoirs is declared finite. Symmetric charge regulators and existing rotor kinetic/form-trace bounds justify the canonical auxiliary extension. The actual finite-aperture F0,D0 then close its remaining static resource gap.
